[[2012 Mountain West Conference men's basketball tournament|Mountain West]] tournament champions |bowl= NCAA Tournament |bowl_result= Third Round }} {{2011–12 Mountain West Conference men's basketball standings}} The '''2011–12 New Mexico Lobos men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of New Mexico]] as a member of the [[Mountain West Conference]]. The Lobos are coached by fifth-year head coach [[Steve Alford]] and play their home games at [[The Pit (arena)|The Pit]] in [[Albuquerque]], [[New Mexico]]. They finished with a record of 28–7 overall, 10–4 in Mountain West play. They were co-champions of the 2012 Mountain West Regular Season Champions with [[2011–12 San Diego State Aztecs men's basketball team|San Diego State]] and won the [[2012 Mountain West Conference men's basketball tournament]]. They earned a 5th seed in the west of the [[2012 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament]].
